literal_meaning: চাপ দিয়ে গুঁজে দেওয়া (squeezed and stuffed)
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাসে টেপা গোঁজা হয়ে যাত্রা করতে হলো।
ঘরে এত লোক টেপা গোঁজা করে বসানো হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: We had to travel crammed in the bus.
The room was filled with people squeezed in tightly.
note: Refers to the common experience of overcrowding in public transport in Bengali-speaking regions.
